description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Repudiate // Replicate and casting three copies of Replicate without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Replicate copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
